blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The issuer whitepaper documents a pauser that stops transfers, minting and burning and a blacklister that prevents transfers to or from selected accounts. Ethereum transaction 0x6ce282329f6081399248e9cdebb8d00bfbb2c4ea0a0c3d849bb2ff8c10bd1e63 succeeded at block 26128999 (2026-10-05T21:56:23Z): caller 0x27e2cef6a4b4634f96b40eda71357ba3d2eb0142 invoked blacklist(address) on the canonical MXNB proxy 0xf197ffc28c23e0309b5559e7a166f2c6164c80aa and emitted Blacklisted for 0x098b716b8aaf21512996dc57eb0615e2383e2f96. This proves exercised local transfer restriction, not a complete cross-chain blacklister census or independent controller custody.

Independent-liability eligibility is deferred until the Arc native-liability route review is complete; no eligibility or static supply shares are authored.
